The engine's list of every permanent on the field now puts a Ticketed stacked on a Unit after that side's backrow cards, as the spec (R4665000) says. Before, it put the card among the Units.

Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Ticketed can stack itself onto an enemy Unit, where it lies on that unit zone: not a Unit, but still a permanent. The rules say a sweep of every permanent meets such a card after its side's backrow zones. One list in the engine still puts it up among the Units instead. That list feeds the plague-placement options, random plague placements, random exiles of the field, and the Radiant-field pool, so on such a board the same seed can offer or hit a different card than the rules' order says. After the fix, every every-permanent list agrees on the pinned order.

## Why

spec/03-zones.md (Stack bullet) pins the order, citing R4665000: a sweep of the backrow, of the Field Spells, or of every permanent meets a lying card after that side's backrow zones. Patch #4760 fixed the sibling lists to match: `enemy_permanents` (crates/engine/src/query.rs), `backrow_of` (crates/engine/src/state_check.rs:120-127), `field_spells_doomed` (crates/engine/src/effects/datacenter.rs:142-145), and `is_adjacent_card` (crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1740-1742). It missed `permanents_on_field` (crates/engine/src/plague.rs:32-38), which walks `acting_on` (crates/engine/src/zones.rs), and that walk pushes every unit-zone top unfiltered, lying cards included. The helper for the pinned spot already exists (`lying_on_unit_zones_of`, crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1767). Consumers of the missed list: plague prompt options and random placements (crates/engine/src/effects/plague.rs:194), random field exiles (crates/engine/src/effects/move_.rs:133), the Radiant-field pool (crates/engine/src/effects/radiant.rs:114), and anomaly copies (crates/engine/src/effects/anomaly.rs:194). Only Ticketed creates lying cards today, so the blast radius is tiny but the divergence is observable through seeded picks.

## Proposal

In `permanents_on_field`, filter lying tops out of each side's `acting_on` pass and append `lying_on_unit_zones_of` after the backrow section, the exact pattern `enemy_permanents` and `backrow_of` already use, and update the doc comment to cite R4665000. Leave `acting_on` itself untouched: aura and field-text reads correctly include the lying top since its auras project. Add a scenario test in the Ticketed module plus one seeded-pick test.

## Where it lands

crates/engine/src/plague.rs (`permanents_on_field`; `reachable_permanents_on_field` inherits it). Tests in crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs, which already holds lying-card scenarios. No spec change: the spec already states the rule, the implementation catches up.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A card lying on a unit zone is met after its side's backrow tops in `permanents_on_field` / `reachable_permanents_on_field`, per side
- [ ] It is met exactly once (count unchanged: no drop, no double-count)
- [ ] Plague placement options list it after backrow cards; seeded random placements and exiles over such a board match the spec order
- [ ] Boards without lying cards produce byte-identical lists (no golden churn outside lying-card games)
- [ ] Engine and card test suites green

## Size and risks

S. Risk is low and bounded: only boards with a card lying on a unit zone (only Ticketed today) combined with these effects change outcome; both seats share the engine so there is no client skew.
